words.def_en: A stage in a competition where the loser is eliminated and cannot continue

words.def_en: A group of players selected to represent a team

words.def_en: The process of being removed from a competition after losing

words.def_en: A chart showing the matchups and path through a tournament

words.def_en: The competitor expected to win — the stronger or more likely side
